pr_title: Generate Diff and Patch direct from Pull head
pr_body:
Fix #10932
Also fix "Empty Diff/Patch File when pull is merged"

Closes #10934

Signed-off-by: Andrew Thornton <art27@cantab.net>
pr_comments: New tests also include steps to ensure that the pulls pages (including commits and files) don't produce a 500 even when the head branch and repository are deleted.

issue_context.title: [Bug] 500 on download pull-diff/patch file of a merged with deleted HeadBranch
comments: solution: if pull is merged and Head branch deleted use merge-commit to get diff or patch

related if merged and branch not deleted: pull-diff/patch is empty

conclusion: only use pull.MergedCommitID

review_comments: What this check doing related to this PR?
It check if the permissions are corect interpreted
so if if fails later ... it is not because of some permissions

It's not so much related to this PR as extending the test in general - however, this is likely the first test to ensure that the pulls page and it's files and commits pages work.

We then ensure that they work after the PR is merged, after the head branch is deleted and after the head repository is deleted. 

Probably we should do the test with deleting head branch and repository before merging too.
But that can be done as a different pr/test.
